'''Kood Gareeda''' was a male [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]]<ref name="And Leebo Makes Three">{{InsiderCite|128|And Leebo Makes Three}}</ref> comedian, who operated throughout the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial era]] and was one of a string of owners of the [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]] [[LE-series repair droid]] [[LE-BO2D9/Legends|LE-BO2D9]], nicknamed Leebo, after the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was stolen from the portmaster at [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]] starport. Leebo served as the comedian's manager, arranging transportation, lodging and performances. The comedian also programmed the droid with a quirky sense of humor to assist in his performances. The comedian's jokes were not always appreciated and he offended an audience on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] with jokes about their leader, [[Navik/Legends|Navik the Red]]. The comedian agreed to trade Leebo to the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]] in exchange for quick passage off Rodia and Rendar dropped him on [[Byblos/Legends|Byblos]].<ref name="SOTES">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>

[[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Maximillian Seerdon]], in a report on Rendar for [[Grand Vizier/Legends|Grand Vizier]] [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]], included information from the ISB's [[Gamma Intelligence Group]] that gave a somewhat different description of the comedian. The ISB reported that he briefly served as Rendar's co-pilot aboard the [[Outrider/Legends|''Outrider'']] until his untimely demise during the first twenty seconds of their debut mission.<ref name="UA:SSWR">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/89/indexp3.html|text=Underworld Appendix: Swoops, Spice, and Wretched Rogues|int=Underworld Appendix: Swoops, Spice, and Wretched Rogues}}</ref>
